name: Mitsuba
source:
A student at Central. She is withdrawn and always stutters.

She's shy, so she cover her eyes with her bangs.

She is on good terms with Nana and longs for her brightness. She is very good at growing plants.

"That... Wow, I...! I'm sorry...!"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
